extDesc.message: Choose the time zone, language, and locale that selected sites see. System time zone and IP address stay unchanged.

mismatchTz.message: Only one of time zone and offset is on. The mismatch can be recognized.

mismatchLocale.message: Only one of language and locale format is on. The mismatch can be recognized.

refreshHint.message: Open pages need a refresh before this applies.

unchanged.message: System time zone and IP address do not change.

invalidSite.message: Enter a concrete HTTPS site. Wildcards and bare domains are not accepted.

uaDesktop.message: Desktop Chrome (same operating system and Chrome major version)

uaSuggestOn.message: Apply recommended will select Desktop Chrome.

uaSuggestOff.message: Apply recommended will keep the real user agent.

fontHint.message: Only canvas measureText and fonts.check are affected. Layout size and pixel comparison stay as they are. The fonts remain installed.

webrtcHint.message: On enabled sites, host, srflx, and prflx candidates that expose an IP address are dropped. Relay candidates and mDNS names stay. No address is invented.

emojiHint.message: Emoji follows the user agent and platform. The site formula still scores at least 1 or 2.

policyBody.message: This disables non-proxied UDP for every site in this browser, not only enabled sites. You can revoke it.

policyConfirm.message: Confirm: disable non-proxied UDP for all sites

policyDenied.message: Permission was not granted. The policy was not changed.

policyBlocked.message: This policy is controlled elsewhere, so it was not changed.

policyNeedConfirm.message: Confirm first. This affects every site and can be revoked.
